`--via-responses` works again without `--model`.

- **Routing model from your catalog:** without `--model`, `--via-responses` used the fixed routing model `gpt-5.5`, which Codex no longer offers to ChatGPT accounts, so the request was refused. It now asks the account's Codex model catalog and routes through the first model listed there. If the catalog can't be read or lists no usable model, it falls back to `gpt-6.1-terra`. `--model` still picks the routing model yourself.
- **Clearer refusal:** when Codex refuses a routing model, the error names the model, lists the models your Codex catalog offers, and says to pick one with `--model <slug>`.
- **Direct route unchanged:** the default route (without `--via-responses`) doesn't use a routing model and makes no catalog call.
